summary: Enable network logging with ANSIBLE_LOG_PATH and ANSIBLE_DEBUG=True and run with -vvvv; the log shows socket creation, connection plugin, auth success and connection time.
questions: How do I enable debug logging for network modules?
Where does Ansible write the network debug log?

answer_card.title: Enable network debug logging
answer_card.answer_md:
On the control node:
```shell
export ANSIBLE_LOG_PATH=~/ansible.log
export ANSIBLE_DEBUG=True
ansible-playbook -vvvv ...
less $ANSIBLE_LOG_PATH
```
Logging is off by default because it's very verbose.
